title: 第5章 还要拜码头？
novel_title: 开局废灵根，成了宗门团宠小师叔
content_zh:
“师兄，我叫顾念念。”

    女孩嗓音清脆，眉眼弯弯，娇憨可爱。

    胡三心里念了一声乖乖，忙笑着摆手。

    “你虽分到杂役院，可仍是内门弟子，可不能叫我师兄。”

    “我名胡三，是这杂役院的管事，你若愿意也可叫我一声三哥。”

    顾念念眯眼笑开，脆生生的唤了一声三哥。

    小姑娘不仅养眼，嘴甜还懂礼，胡三嘴角的笑越发真诚。

    他觉得自己的盘算应该能成。

    宗主的女儿，哪怕是个废物，只是这一层身份，已经足够他做文章了。

    是的，就在洛靳离开的一瞬间，他已经将顾念念摸了个底。

    自然也知道了测试台那边的事情。

    况且，

    他目光再次扫过顾念念怀里抱着的桃夭。

    那可是桃夭啊！

    全宗门无人不知的桃夭仙剑，这可是洛靳洛师兄在天渊秘境里带出来的唯一先天灵宝。

    整个修真界，先天灵宝不出十件。

    无数人求取，可无论提出什么条件，洛靳都不曾让出。

    如今却到了一个小姑娘手中。

    仅凭这一点，胡三也要把小姑娘照顾好了。

    他入青云宗八百年了，在这杂役院足足七百年，他待够了。

    可他是散修入门，无背景人脉，只能日日在这里苦熬着。

    现在，终于有机会了。

    他猛然一捏手，暗暗下定决心，这一次他一定要离开杂役院，哪怕只还是个外门的记名弟子，也比这杂役院的管事强上百倍。

    “走，我带你去住处。”

    顾念念跟在胡三的身后，一边走一边看。

    这里和她先前看到的完全不同。

    到处都很破，房子破旧，竹竿上晾晒的衣服也很破旧。

    像是她住过的贫民窟，透着熟悉。

    无人上来说话，也无人交流。

    看到胡三那些人会行礼，神色中除了麻木还有隐隐的恐慌。

    顾念念歪着头去看胡三。

    察觉到她的视线，胡三微微低头，脸上带着笑，很是亲切。

    “想问什么？”

    顾念念抱紧了怀里的桃夭，犹豫了一下，还是问了。

    “他们也跟我一样吗？”

    小姑娘咬着下唇，神色中带着某种奇怪的急切，她极力掩盖，却还是让胡三看的分明。

    他抬头看向不远处忙碌的杂役，眼底的笑变成了一种冷漠的奚落。

    “不，他们是被废去修为的罪人。”

    顾念念眼底划过失望。

    原来不是同伴啊。

    不知怎的，她忽然想到了洛靳，然后又想到了顾衍，最后想到了老乞丐。
content_en:
"Senior brother, my name is Gu Niannian."

    The girl has a clear voice, curved eyebrows, and is cute.

    Hu San muttered "Guaiguai" in his heart and waved his hands with a smile.

    "Although you are assigned to the miscellaneous service courtyard, you are still an inner disciple, so you cannot call me senior brother."

    "My name is Hu San, and I am the steward of this courtyard. You can call me Third Brother if you like."

    Gu Niannian narrowed her eyes and smiled, calling out to third brother.

    The little girl is not only eye-catching, but also sweet-tongued and polite. The smile at the corner of Hu San's mouth becomes more and more sincere.

    He felt that his plan should come true.

    Even if the sect leader's daughter is a loser, her status is enough for him to make a fuss about.

    Yes, the moment Luo Jin left, he had already touched Gu Niannian.

    Naturally, I also knew what happened on the test bench.

    Moreover,

    His eyes once again glanced at Taoyao held in Gu Niannian's arms.

    That’s Taoyao!

    The Taoyao Immortal Sword, which is known to everyone in the entire sect, is the only innate spiritual treasure brought out by Senior Brother Luo Jinluo in the Tianyuan Secret Realm.

    In the entire world of cultivation, there are no more than ten innate spiritual treasures.

    Countless people asked for it, but no matter what conditions they put forward, Luo Jin never gave in.

    Now it's in the hands of a little girl.

    Based on this alone, Hu San must take good care of the little girl.

    He has been a member of the Qingyun Sect for eight hundred years, and has been in this courtyard for a full seven hundred years. He has had enough.

    But he was just starting out as a casual cultivator and had no connections, so he could only suffer here every day.

    Now, finally there is a chance.

    He suddenly squeezed his hands and secretly made up his mind that this time he must leave the Servant Academy. Even if he was only a registered disciple of the outer sect, he would be a hundred times better than the steward of the Servant Academy.

    "Come on, I'll take you to your apartment."

    Gu Niannian followed Hu San, watching as he walked.

    This place was completely different from what she had seen before.

    Everything is dilapidated, the houses are dilapidated, and the clothes hanging on bamboo poles are also dilapidated.

    It seemed familiar to the slums she had lived in.

    No one came up to speak, and no one communicated.

    Seeing Hu San and the others saluting, their expressions were not only numb but also faintly panicked.

    Gu Niannian tilted her head to look at Hu San.

    Sensing her gaze, Hu San lowered his head slightly, with a smile on his face, very cordial.

    "What do you want to ask?"

    Gu Niannian hugged Taoyao tightly in her arms, hesitated for a moment, and then asked.

    "Are they like me?"

    The little girl bit her lower lip, with a strange eagerness in her expression. She tried her best to hide it, but Hu San could still see it clearly.

    He looked up at the busy handyman not far away, and the smile in his eyes turned into a cold sneer.

    "No, they are sinners whose cultivation has been abolished."

    Disappointment flashed in Gu Niannian's eyes.

    It turns out he is not a companion.

    Somehow, she suddenly thought of Luo Jin, then Gu Yan, and finally the old beggar.
